name: FactorioServerManager
description: A tool for managing Factorio servers This tool runs on a Factorio server and allows management of the Factorio server, saves, mods and many other features. Features - Allows control of the Factorio Server, starting and stopping the Factorio binary - Allows the management of save files, upload, download and delete saves. - Manage installed mods, upload new ones and more - Manage modpacks, so it is easier to play with different configurations - Allow viewing of the server logs and current configuration. - Authentication for protecting against unauthorized users Check the Log of the Container to see the Inital Admin Password
